minimum_sample_size.note: Do not evaluate any activation trigger before 30 complete sessions are logged.

signal_1_items_per_session.name: items_per_session
signal_1_items_per_session.description: Mean number of noun/10K items shown per complete 24-step session

signal_2_exposure_distribution.name: per_item_exposure_skew
signal_2_exposure_distribution.description: Distribution of shown_count across all 13 active noun/10K items
signal_2_exposure_distribution.underexposure_condition: any single item with shown_count = 0 after 30 qualifying sessions

signal_3_repeat_rate.name: per_user_repeat_rate
signal_3_repeat_rate.description: Fraction of noun/10K items in session N that were also seen in session N-1 for the same user

thresholds.concern: >33% — pool too thin relative to session depth

signal_3_repeat_rate.note: With 13 items and 2–3 shown per session, a 3-item session with 2 carry-overs = 67% — critical.

signal_4_correctness_rate.name: per_item_correctness_rate
signal_4_correctness_rate.description: Percentage of correct answers per item; diagnostic validity check

calibration_bands.action: flag for re-evaluation as B1 candidate

signal_4_correctness_rate.note: These are not hard cutoffs — diagnostic contract requires human review, not automatic action.

saturation_definition.description: Pool is saturated when items repeat faster than the pool can rotate
saturation_definition.saturation_warning_rule: criteria_1_prerequisite met + any one of C1, C2, or C3

underexposure_definition.description: Pool is underexposed when items are not seen enough for reliable measurement

conditions.condition: any item with shown_count < 3 while pool mean > 8
average noun_10k_shown per session < 1.0 across 30 sessions

activation_triggers.condition: per-user repeat rate > 33% over the last 30 sessions
mean noun_10k_items per session < 1.5 over 10 consecutive sessions
fewer than 10 of 13 items have shown_count ≥ 3 after 30 sessions
any single item shown_count ≥ 8 while pool median shown_count < 3

do_not_activate_if: fewer than 30 complete sessions in the data
real learner data unavailable (synthetic runs only do not count)
any item with ≥5 answers has pct_correct < 20% (unresolved item flaw — fix first)
a pending constraint audit has not been run (Rule 1 anti-collision must be re-verified against expanded active bank before staging)

selection_priorities: prefer CLEAN items over WARN items in collision_note
avoid activating both items from any intra-cluster WARN pair in the same tranche
diversify concept_group: at most 2 items from the same concept_group per tranche
re-run Rule 1 anti-collision check against expanded active bank before applying
next_tranche_guidance.example_blocked_pair: do not activate both tornozelo and cotovelo simultaneously — cotovelo is already active

six_choice_incompatibility_risk.reason: modes/vocab/selector.py is not wired to runtime. services/vocab_runtime/selector.py has no choice count filter.
six_choice_incompatibility_risk.trigger_for_action: if any migration toward modes/vocab/selector.py or a variant requiring 6 choices is planned
resolution_options: drop HAVING COUNT(*) = 6 from async selector
rebuild all new noun/10K items to 6 choices before async migration
